content:
A class was not recorded
Tenant: Example school. The Recording stopped before it finished, so there is no complete video for this class. Affected items: 2.
An engineer must check immediately whether any retained source can be recovered; a complete video cannot be promised.
For engineers: recording; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.

A class video could not be produced
Tenant: Example school. The class was recorded, but turning it into a video file failed or is taking longer than 14 hours. Affected items: 2.
An engineer needs to fix the cause and retry the Export before the retained Recording expires; check its source cleanup deadline now. Earliest affected source expires at 2099-01-01T12:00:00Z.
For engineers: export; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.

A class transcript failed or is taking longer than 30 minutes
Tenant: Example school. The video is not affected. Affected items: 2.
An engineer needs to check the source expiry and retry before it expires; a transcript cannot be promised. Earliest affected source expires at 2099-01-01T12:00:00Z.
For engineers: transcript; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.

A customer's system was not told about a class event
Tenant: Example school. Chalk tried several times to reach the customer's server and gave up, so their attendance or Recording records may be out of date. Affected items: 2.
An engineer must check the customer's server now, then redeliver the event; automatic retries have ended.
For engineers: webhook; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.

Chalk is returning errors to people in class
More than fifteen server errors occurred in five minutes. Joining, loading or starting a Recording may be failing right now. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.
An engineer must investigate now; customers may need to reconnect after the cause is fixed.
For engineers: api; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from an affected response or connection.

People are being disconnected from classes or cannot connect right now
More than ten failed connections or abnormal drops occurred in five minutes. Normal leaves and server drains are excluded. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.
An engineer must investigate now; customers may need to reconnect after the cause is fixed.
For engineers: sync; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from an affected response or connection.

The alert system has stopped reporting
Chalk may be working, but nobody would be told about a job or webhook failure until this is fixed.
An engineer must restore the alert collector now; until then job and webhook failures may go unnoticed.
For engineers: freshness; `systemctl status chalk-alert-state.timer chalk-alert-state.service`.

The alert threshold is no longer exceeded
Earlier alert: A class video could not be produced. Tenant: Example school. The class was recorded, but turning it into a video file failed or is taking longer than 14 hours.
This does not prove the earlier failure was fixed. An engineer must check the earlier message and affected records; do not treat this as recovery.
For engineers: export; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.

TEST: Chalk alert delivery
No customer failure was induced.
This only tests notification delivery; no customer action is needed.
For engineers: delivery-test; query structured logs by W3C trace ID from the affected journey.
